field_text_formatted.value: The last is behaviour, not configuration. A Drupal session already open in the browser is refused, rather than signing the visitor in as whoever left it there. The error sets sessionInUse so your form can say why. To end that session instead, point sessionLogout at a route you write yourself in Drupal. Core will not do it.
